board: Bluetooth Nugget (LOLIN S3 Mini), production unit. First probed in ROM download mode with CircuitPython installed (never reset); then reflashed with WLEDkitty (bluetooth-nugget-wled, sha256 abc94829…) and probed again from the running HWCDC app via esptool default_reset -> hard_reset
measured: 2026-09-21, workbench5 (Raspberry Pi 5) via scripts/probe_bridge.py over ssh, flasher stub
chip_artefacts_ignored: GPIO38 LOW, GPIO39/40 HIGH on every ESP32-S3 measured so far (JTAG pins in ROM mode) — not board signatures
notes: GPIO35/36 HIGH = the 4.7k OLED I2C pull-ups — the family discriminator, now measured on both sides
button lines 11/12/13/18 FLOAT: the 10k pull-ups on the nugget_v3 3.14 schematic are not on this board (firmware uses internal pull-ups)
GPIO47 (S3 Mini onboard WS2812 data) reads LOW; on the S3-Zero the LED pin GPIO21 reads HIGH — possible module-level tell, n=1 each
flash/env layer not run: pins alone were decisive (no readFlash needed)
HWCDC round trip verified: default_reset out of running WLED -> probe -> hard_reset -> SPI_FAST_FLASH_BOOT, app-region Saved PC (0x420e0286) on the next check

HWCDC DTR trap reproduced: opening the CDC with DTR asserted then releasing RTS reset the running app into DOWNLOAD (boot:0x0); open with DTR+RTS both low (the slot proxy's sequence) boots it normally
